thread:
sophie: FYI  Big regulated tenant asked for a "pin escape hatch" flow: they want strict residency, guaranteed rollback SLA, and a documented migration escrow. Need a quick spec sketch we can show them.

rahul: Can you paste the customer bullets?

sophie: Sure - copied from the intake:
  • Tenant pin up to 180 days, EU-only for some models
  • Clear rollback SLA (4h P1) for safety incidents
  • Migration escrow credits if we force-retire a pinned model
  • Audit trail & exportable billing lines for pins

ida: High level: default public offering = 90d TTL; enterprise add-on = 180d with reserved capacity and SOW. For EU residency we need region constraints + per-tenant KMS.

chris: Ops: rollback SLA sounds tight. Recommend: we document an emergency-unpin runbook and a 4h target for acknowledgement + 24h for full rollback depending on dataset size. Include comm templates.

rahul: Bench gates: canonical harness = seq512, 200 sample eval. Acceptance: gen p95 <= 180ms (default) / <= 130ms (reserved). Embedding cosine drift <= 3.5%. Cost delta cap 2.0x.

ida: Preflight CI must run bench + golden-eval + regional smoke test. Pin is only active if CI passes. If CI fails, API returns non-200 with failure summary.

billing-bot: Billing export request: include pin_tier, pin_fee, reserved_surcharge, pin_reason, pin_expiry, pinned_by. Migration credits should appear as invoice adjustments tied to forced-retire events.

legal-bot: Legal note: include clause that if third-party upstream changes cause safety/regression we may suspend pins; we must notify customer and provide migration credit per escrow schedule. Also need retention language for audit logs.

chris: Fallback behavior: default = attempt compatible fallback variant then notify. Strict_mode opt-in = no fallback -> 503 on mismatch. Must be explicit in API and Console.

ida: Registry changes: add flags pin_allowed, pin_tier, region_constraint, strict_mode_supported, unsupported_reason. Also expose approval_workflow_id for Reserved pins.

rahul: UX: Console pin card shows tier, expiry countdown, region badge, and a one-click "request extension" that opens approval flow. Also show a quick compat check (50-sample bench) inline.

ida: Monitoring signals: pinned_latency_p95, pin_fallback_count, pinned_eval_fail_rate, pin_suspended_flag. Alert: pinned_eval_fail_rate > 2% -> page oncall. Wire metrics into billing export with pin metadata.

chris: Emergency runbook snippet:
```
# emergency suspension
rwd-admin pin suspend --tenant TID --pin PID --reason "safety-suspend"
# quick fallback
rwd-admin pin fallback --tenant TID --pin PID --variant VAR_ID
```
Include templates for customer comms and internal postmortem steps.

rahul: Migration escrow policy: first forced-retire -> 60d reserved-capacity credits; subsequent retirements prorated. Also provide a migration-runner CLI that automates dry-run and cutover.

legal-bot: We'll draft a short SOW template for the 180d Reserved SKU and an emergency-unpin clause. Also require audit metadata: pinned_by, approval_ticket, pin_reason, s0w_id for Reserved.

ida: Preflight checklist owner: I'll write the bench + CI checklist. rahul -> registry changes, chris -> runbook & monitoring, sophie -> consolidate spec and share with customer.

sophie: Timeline: quick draft by Thu EOD, internal review Fri, customer review next week. Using this thread as canonical notes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
